info.name: Omar Khalil – Assets, Incidents and Playbooks
info.description: Omar Khalil – Run folders in order against a seeded development database. Authentication uses the real login API. Each endpoint includes success, invalid-input (or explicitly inapplicable bodyless variant), unknown-resource/route, wrong-role and missing-token cases. Repeat runs create fresh records and IDs are saved automatically.
